name: Isabel Flores — birth in July 1880, San Pablo, Laguna, Philippines
researcher_question: When and where was Isabel Flores born, the wife of Fermin Barleta (born 1878) and mother of Aproniano (1904), Cesario (1908) and Florentina (1911) Barleta of San Pablo, Laguna, Philippines?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-3.csv row 19, hint-samples.csv row 660, flags adds_birth/adds_christening, confidence 3). Resolved TRUE MATCH on an INDEX-ONLY route: the 1880 San Pablo baptism (ark:/61903/1:1:666Y-8VPJ) names Isabel's parents Policronio Flores + Catalina Ortiz with maternal grandparents Antonio Ortes + Rita Gusmán and paternal grandmother María Gulaglay; the parents' 1877 San Pablo marriage (ark:/61903/1:1:XWM9-CGG8) names Apolonio Flores (son of Fulgencio Flores + Maria Gulaylay) marrying Catalina Ortis (daughter of Antonio Ortis + Rita Gusman). Catalina's parents (Antonio Ortis + Rita Gusman) match the 1880 maternal grandparents (Antonio Ortes + Rita Gusmán, spelling variants), a strong indication of the same Catalina, and the husband is recorded as Apolonio with mother Maria Gulaylay matching the 1880 paternal grandmother — so the 1880 'Policronio' is best explained as a scribal variant of Apolonio, the name in the tree and in the children's 1908 and 1911 baptisms (the couple's first child Aproniano is dated about 1904 from later records; no 1904 baptism index was located). Competing Apolinario-Barleta x Isabela-Flores couple (1871, ark:/61903/1:1:XWMQ-426F) excluded on generation; no other Flores child of Catalina Ortiz found 1865-1895; no childhood burial found. The couple's own ~1900-1903 marriage is unindexed and its register volume (007771115) is image-restricted (403), so not used. image_basis false: the resolution rests on index evidence; the 1880 baptism image was read only as a non-load-bearing cross-check, and its grandparent spellings and the 'difunta' (deceased) note for Rita Gusman are not licensed by the Step-1a check and are not used.
